policy_facts: The sealed Seedelf history now keeps, for what each spend of the wallet's own leaves in the private balance (a stealth mint's change and its Seedelf, a private pool start's change, a Send's or Make public's change, a removed Seedelf's ADA), a part naming that spend's transaction (change:<tx>). For a Make public to one of the user's own public accounts, it keeps that account (public:<n>) instead.

For a box's way back (a lovejoin-withdraw entry), the history now keeps whether the wallet recorded a mix moving that box (origin 'mixed'). Otherwise it keeps what put the box there: the private session whose deposit did (session:<n>), or Unknown (unknown:<tx>) where the wallet can't tell. After a restore the session comes from which of the phrase's one-time keys paid the deposit, derived on the device.
Nothing new is sent and no request is added. Only on-device sealed values change, so a stealth mint, a pool start and a funding take money others paid, and a box a mix moved, before such change.
